faqs.question: How much does a recording session cost?
faqs.answer: Recording sessions are $75 per hour with a 2 hour minimum. Reach out if you need mixing, mastering, beat production, or podcast pricing.

faqs.question: Do you work with beginner artists?

faqs.question: What genres do you record?
faqs.answer: We work with reggaeton, Latin, rap, trap, urban, singers, and Christian artists in San Antonio and beyond.

prepCards.title: Hydrate Your Voice
prepCards.description: Drink water, avoid dairy before recording, and warm up your voice if you are singing or recording melodic vocals.

problemCards.title: Inconsistent Recording
problemCards.desc: Songs get started but never fully finished. Momentum fades, releases get delayed, and progress slows down.

problemCards.title: No Release Strategy
problemCards.desc: Music gets dropped randomly without a plan, which makes it harder to build attention and long-term growth.

problemCards.title: Lack of Direction
problemCards.desc: Many artists need honest feedback, song selection help, branding direction, and accountability to move forward.

whatItIs.paragraph1: This program combines professional recording support, creative direction, release strategy guidance, and accountability to help artists grow with structure and intention.
whatItIs.paragraph2: It is not a label deal and not empty motivation. It is real development support designed for artists who are serious about improving their music, strengthening their brand, and building long-term momentum.

roadmapCards.title: Month 1 — Direction
roadmapCards.desc: We evaluate your sound, strengths, and goals. Recording begins while identifying your strongest songs and creative lane.

roadmapCards.title: Month 2 — Development
roadmapCards.desc: Songs are refined, stronger records are created, and we begin shaping your next releases and artist branding.

roadmapCards.title: Month 3 — Momentum
roadmapCards.desc: Your best records move toward release while we build a stronger long-term strategy for more consistent output.

fitForYou.title: You're a Strong Fit If You:
items: Are actively creating music and want more structure
Want guidance on release strategy and branding
Are open to honest feedback and direction
Want long-term growth, not random sessions

notForYou.eyebrow: Why This Is Not For You
notForYou.title: This Program May Not Be For You If:
items: You only want one quick session with no long-term plan
You are not ready to record consistently
You do not want feedback or creative direction
You are looking for instant results without real work
You are not ready for a 3-month commitment
You want management or label services instead of development support

processCards.title: Step 1

processCards.title: Step 3
processCards.desc: If accepted, we begin building your recording plan, creative direction, and release strategy.
